title: Garlicky Tofu Tabbouleh with Parsley and Mint
changes_from_base: Golden garlicky tofu crumbs are added for protein, and the bulgur softens in lemon and tomato juice instead of water.
summary: A herb-packed tabbouleh with golden, garlicky tofu crumbs for protein: parsley, mint, tomato and bulgur in a lemony dressing. Vegan.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for draining the tomatoes
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Drain tomatoes, soak bulgur
steps.text: Salt the tomatoes in the sieve and drain 30 min. Mix the bulgur with half the lemon juice and 2 tbsp of the drained tomato juice and leave to soften.

steps.title: Crumble the tofu
steps.text: Press the tofu dry between paper towels, pulse it a few times in the processor to coarse crumbs and blot again.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat 10-12 min until golden. Push it aside, add the garlic to the centre for 1 min, then stir together with salt and pepper. Cool.

steps.title: Toss and rest
steps.text: Whisk the rest of the lemon juice with the oil, cayenne and salt, add the tomatoes, bulgur, tofu and herbs and toss. Rest 1 hour for the bulgur to finish softening.

tips: Press the tofu well so it browns rather than steams.
Chop the herbs with a sharp knife so they do not bruise.
Let it rest the full hour so the bulgur softens.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 1 day; the herbs darken after that. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
